standard_prerequisites.name: Tree conditions of the forcing used for WKL
standard_prerequisites.statement: In this section a condition is a pair (sigma, T) of a finite binary string and an M-infinite tree, and an extension (tau, T_2) of (sigma, T_1) requires tau to extend sigma and T_2 to be contained in T_1, so that the conditions form a forcing of tree type; the requirements of this forcing are listed by the author at source lines 640-643.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the objects of the counted lemma, namely the condition (sigma, T_1), the extension (sigma, T_2) it produces and the generics G and Y.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Shore-blocking functional Gamma_k and well-foundedness of the natural product
standard_prerequisites.statement: Gamma_k is the Turing functional constructed by the author in the Shore-blocking lemma, which turns a descending sequence below an ordinal into one below the natural product with k, and the article proves separately that well-foundedness of an ordinal transfers to its natural product with any coefficient; both statements are retained with this card at source lines 426-431 and 411-413.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma is stated for exactly this functional and its proof derives a contradiction from the hypothesis that Gamma_k is total, using the transfer of well-foundedness to the natural product.

standard_prerequisites.name: Definability classes and M-finiteness in the model
standard_prerequisites.statement: Sets defined by primitive recursive predicates in a real Y are available in the model, and the article uses throughout that M-infinite trees can be cut down by such predicates while staying M-infinite when the corresponding set is M-infinite.
standard_prerequisites.use: In the first case the proof cuts the tree T_1 down by the primitive Y-recursive predicate that the functional diverges at a fixed n.

core_obligations: Normalise the functional by twisting so that convergence of Gamma^sigma_k at n forces convergence at every smaller input and makes the values a strictly decreasing sequence of ordinals below beta ntimes k (source lines 688-692).

Case one: assume there is n such that for every level ell there is a string tau in T_1 of length ell at which the functional diverges at n; cut the tree down to the set T_2 of such tau, note that T_2 is primitive Y-recursive, closed downward and M-infinite, and conclude that the extension (sigma, T_2) forces divergence of the functional at n (source line 695).

Case two: assume that for every n there is a level ell_n beyond which the functional converges at n on every string of T_1 of that length, and define alpha_n as the maximum of the values at n over the strings of length ell_n (source lines 698-701).

Show that alpha_{n+1} is strictly below alpha_n: for every tau of length ell_{n+1} the twisted convergence property compares the value at n+1 on tau with the value at n on the restriction of tau to ell_n, and taking maxima preserves the strict inequality (source lines 702-707).

Conclude that the model fails WF(alpha ntimes k), contradicting the transfer of well-foundedness to the natural product which holds because the model satisfies collection for Sigma^0_2 plus WF(alpha); the contradiction rules out case two and leaves the forcing statement of case one, which is the counted lemma (source line 708).

proof_roadmap.step: Twist the functional so that its convergence is monotone and its values strictly decrease.
Case one: cut the tree by the primitive Y-recursive divergence predicate and read off the forcing statement.
Case two: define the maxima alpha_n of the values on the levels ell_n.
Prove the maxima strictly decrease, contradicting well-foundedness of the natural product.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Lemma lem:wkl-wf-forcing-wf（源 683-685 行，证明 687-709 行）：在 WKL 的树力迫下，任一条件都有扩展强制 Shore-blocking 泛函 Gamma_k 成为部分函数。关键操作不是例行核验：证明按「是否存在某个 n 使发散在任意高度都出现」分成两支——第一支把树按原始递归的发散谓词剪下来，必须验证新树仍 M-无穷且使力迫关系成立（695 行）；第二支定义各层的最大值 alpha_n，再用扭泛函后的单调性证明 alpha_{n+1} < alpha_n（702-707 行），从而得到与 M 满足 WF(alpha ⨯ k) 的矛盾——而这一步又依赖另一张卡对应的 WF 乘积传递引理与 collection（708 行）。难点在于两支的取舍与把「M-无穷」在剪枝后保住；原文位置在证明的 695 行与 698-708 行。

editorial_notes: The counted unit is the article's own Lemma lem:wkl-wf-forcing-wf at source lines 683-685 together with the proof environment that begins two lines after the statement ends (687-709); the pairing is the ordinary adjacent one.

The retained context at source lines 411-413 and 426-431 is the statement of the two earlier lemmas that the counted proof invokes through the author Cref calls, namely the transfer of well-foundedness to the natural product and the Shore-blocking functional; both are retained as prerequisites, their proofs are not retained. The retained context at source line 663 is the author explanation of the forcing relation for a decided initial segment of the jump.

The retained preamble reproduces verbatim the author's document class at source line 2, his theorem declarations at source lines 16-25, his macro definitions at source lines 46-88 and 91, his natural-operation macros at source lines 104-107 and his quotation macro at source line 116, and it retains mathabx from source line 103 and the cancel package from source line 9, the latter because the retained proof prints a negated satisfaction sign. The LS2 font-encoding block at source lines 93-99 is not retained because the host TeX Live has no stix directory and the author never uses that symbol. The inputenc load with the utf8x option at source line 8 is not retained because it fights the forced xelatex engine, and cleveref is loaded by the retained preamble itself because the assembler only adds that package when it generates navigation stubs.
No retained line contains a citation, so the material carries no bibliography; the cross-references of the retained proof are all resolved inside the retained context.
The article's conservation theorems, its COH lemmas and its SEM section lemmas are not counted here and are not used as premises.
